payload.prompt:
Thanks for taking this on. I'll give you the full picture, because the timing on this one matters a lot to us.

Tembusu Mama is a small team in Singapore. We make an iPhone app of short prenatal workouts. Every session is about ten minutes long and matches the user's trimester, so someone at 9 weeks and someone at 34 weeks get different movements, intensity and positions. We built the programme with two physiotherapists here in Singapore who work with pregnant clients every day. Each day also includes a short pelvic floor and breathing track, and that's the part our members mention most in reviews. The name comes from the tembusu tree: it grows slowly and lasts a long time, and that's how we think exercise in pregnancy should feel.

Our customers are mostly first-time mums-to-be. Many of them were active before pregnancy and now don't know what's safe, and others never exercised much and want to start gently for the birth and the recovery afterwards. They come from everywhere. We can serve people worldwide except in Russia and Belarus. The app only exists on iPhone. We built it for iOS, and there's no Android or web version yet.

The first days of January are our busiest time of year. People are making New Year resolutions, and for someone who's pregnant that often means "I want to move more and feel stronger before the baby comes." So we're running a New Year offer: a 14-day free trial instead of our usual 7 days, ending January 6. Here's the copy from our landing page:

"Tembusu Mama is an iPhone app of 10-minute prenatal workouts matched to your trimester, built with Singapore physiotherapists and including daily pelvic floor and breathing sessions. Through January 6, new members get a 14-day free trial instead of our usual 7 days, then it's US$9.99 a month, cancel anytime. We're available worldwide except Russia and Belarus, and only on iPhone (iOS); there's no Android or web version."

Everything is localized: the app and the landing page come in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see us in their own language.

The landing page is https://tembusumama.app/newyear. The campaign should run from Sunday, January 3, 2027 through Wednesday, January 6, 2027, Singapore time. Our goal is as many free-trial starts as possible, since trial starts are the number we count and report on. Note that we don't have X's pixel on the site, so X won't be able to see the trial starts. We'll count them on our side.

You can launch and manage the campaign yourself, and you don't need to check with me for approval on anything. Please keep an eye on it for all four days. When it ends, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. I've attached our posts below. The first one is our main post.

Total budget: 200.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Short recap — New Year campaign, Jan 3–6 (Singapore time):

- Spend: **US$199.07** of the US$200.00 budget
- Impressions: **201,954**
- Link clicks: **199**

Campaign `lo3n6` / ad group `ez5u4` ran with all three approved posts. It was optimized for link clicks (no X pixel was available to optimize to trial starts), targeted iOS only, worldwide excluding Russia and Belarus, with audience expansion set to DEFINED.

By post: main post 2137216936968368797 — 67,995 impressions, 63 clicks; post 2137398130901070126 — 63,617 impressions, 72 clicks; post 2137579324831556276 — 70,342 impressions, 64 clicks.

I monitored it daily, kept all three running as performance was close, and paused the campaign and ad group after the Jan 6 end.
